askToolRounds.description: The most rounds of one Ask box question that may call tools, before one last round without; 0 or unset is 5 (D-208)

askToolCalls.description: The most tool calls one Ask box question runs in all; 0 or unset is 10 (D-208)

askOutputTokens.description: The most output tokens the model may write for one Ask box question, all its calls together; 0 or unset is 800 (D-208)

askDeadline.description: The longest one Ask box question may take, from 10s to 5m; unset is 2m (D-208)
